# CK Claude Plugins

> Free, open-source (MIT) plugins for Claude Code, Anthropic's agentic coding tool. ck-code brings spec-driven development to AI coding; ck-code-lite is its four-skill fast path; ck-tools is a repo utility toolkit with a plan-limit pace band. Install from the ck-marketplace Claude Code plugin marketplace.

Install: `/plugin marketplace add ckandrinirina/ck-code`, then `/plugin install ck-code@ck-marketplace` (or `ck-code-lite@ck-marketplace`, `ck-tools@ck-marketplace`), restart Claude Code, and enable per project with `"enabledPlugins": { "ck-code@ck-marketplace": true }` in `.claude/settings.json`.

## Plugins

- [ck-code](https://ckandrinirina.github.io/ck-claude-plugins/ck-code.html): spec-driven workflow — spec → architecture docs → epics and sized stories → per-project expert skills → TDD builds by lean sub-agents (one story on its own branch, or many in parallel git worktrees; a whole epic unattended with `--auto`; QA runs only the tests a change can reach, found by tracing imports, plus every test of each area it touches) → whole-feature manual test checklist (`/ck-code:verify`, resumable, grouped by epic) → commits, PRs, GitHub Issues and a Projects board tracked to merge.
- [ck-code-lite](https://ckandrinirina.github.io/ck-claude-plugins/ck-code-lite.html): four skills (start, design, build, ship) and two files (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, split into docs/areas/ as it grows; tasks/PLAN.md, read and written only by the ck-lite script) — test-first builds with isolated QA (only the tests a change can reach, plus an area check before push) and manual sign-off, parallel waves (unattended with `--auto`), current stack versions from the registry and best practices from context7 cached in `## Stack`, design first with Claude Design (Claude writes the brief, then UI tasks build against the cached design system), for small apps and prototypes. A small mod (Claude Code ≥ 2.1.287) adds a progress band above the prompt, flat-glyph tool rows, each task builder's live task list on the band, a toast for each finished task, self-compaction after a wave run, and `/lite-status`, `/lite-waves`, `/lite-check` with no model turn. Upgrades to ck-code with `/ck-code:migrate`.
- [ck-tools](https://ckandrinirina.github.io/ck-claude-plugins/ck-tools.html): repo utilities for any git project — deliver (conventional commit + PR), implement, dependency-upgrade, gh-issue, release-prep, showcase, bmad-guide; plus a band above the prompt with the 5-hour and weekly Claude plan limits, a pace verdict (safe, tight, runs out in …) and reset times.

## ck-code commands

init, spec, design, team, plan, track, build, fix, verify, ship, explain, guide, doctor, config, migrate — each invoked as `/ck-code:<name>`. The ck-code mod (Claude Code ≥ 2.1.287) adds commands that print with no model turn — `/ck-status`, `/ck-next`, `/ck-progress`, `/ck-waves NN`, `/ck-check` — plus `/ck-agents` (live agents pane), `/ck-verify-pane` (checklist with buttons), `/ck-band` (the story band above the prompt; the session also compacts itself after a wave run) and `/ck-profile` (time and tokens per skill); in a ck-code project it draws tool rows with flat glyphs (⌕ search, ≡ read, ± edit, ◈ agent) and mirrors each story builder's task list onto the band; its cost guard caps effort at high, asks before any Fable dispatch, and code search and research run on Haiku agents (`context-scout`, `researcher`).
